en.headline: Japanese indie-pop trio Chilli Beans. returns for solo Hong Kong show on 30 August
en.dek: The group, known for the One Piece ending theme Raise and recent Netflix work, performs at Tides after their Clockenflap appearance late last year.
body: Japanese indie-pop trio Chilli Beans. will stage a solo concert in Hong Kong on 30 August at Tides, following their earlier appearance at Clockenflap.

The band, comprising Moto on vocals, Maika on bass and vocals, and Lily on guitar and vocals, handles its own songwriting, composition and arrangement. Their single Lemonade topped Spotify Viral charts, and they have contributed the ending theme Raise for the long-running anime One Piece as well as the theme star flower for a Netflix series.

Tickets are priced at HK$1,080 and HK$680 for standing places. A limited VIP package includes priority entry, a commemorative laminate, an autographed poster and a post-show individual photo opportunity. The organisers said the show forms part of the group’s 2026-2027 tour.

zh.headline: 日本獨立流行組合Chilli Beans. 8月30日再臨香港專場
zh.dek: 憑《海賊王》片尾曲Raise及Netflix動畫主題曲成名的三人組合，繼去年Clockenflap後於Tides舉行演唱會。
body: 日本獨立流行三人組合Chilli Beans. 將於8月30日晚在Tides舉行香港專場演唱會，繼去年底於Clockenflap演出後再度來港。
組合由主音Moto、低音結他及主音Maika，以及結他及主音Lily組成，詞曲編排皆由成員親自負責。單曲《Lemonade》曾登上Spotify Viral榜首，其後為長壽動畫《海賊王》獻上片尾曲《Raise》，並為Netflix動畫創作主題曲《star flower》。
門票分為1,080港元及680港元全企位，另設限量VIP套票，包括優先入場、紀念卡牌、親簽海報及演出後一對一合照。主辦方表示，是次演出屬組合2026-2027巡演的一部分。
